title: get-openbao-status output
description: Get the OpenBao server state: initialization and seal status

threshold.description: Number of key shares required to unseal

progress.description: Key shares provided so far for the current unseal

ui_url.description: OpenBao web UI URL; empty if the host name is not configured

user_domain.description: User domain used for directory login; empty if disabled

module_token.description: State of the module token used for snapshots and root token detection

root_token_present.description: A root token exists; null if unknown (no module token, sealed, or too many tokens)

seal_migration_from.description: Previous unseal mode while a seal migration (openbao-seal-migrate) is in progress; empty otherwise

migration.description: OpenBao is waiting for keys with 'bao operator unseal -migrate'

is_self.description: This instance is the active (leader) node; null when unknown

peers.description: Raft peers, read with the module token; null when not readable
